scripts.dev: sh -c "sh scripts/build-wasm.sh --dev && { sh scripts/build-wasm.sh --dev --watch & exec pnpm --filter web exec vite; }"
scripts.build: pnpm gen:types && pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:vite && node scripts/check-hosts.mjs
scripts.check: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo deny check && pnpm --filter web exec eslint . && pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit -p tests-e2e/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-file-tree.mjs && sh scripts/check-gen-clean.sh && node scripts/check-copy-codes.mjs
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter web exec vitest run
